findings.title: New ping_worker behavior has no regression coverage
findings.impact: The new helper adds input validation for host/count and maps the system ping return code to a boolean, but the PR adds no unit test that would fail if validation is removed, invalid arguments are accepted, or ping failures are reported as success.
findings.fix: Add a focused test for ping_worker that mocks subprocess.run and covers a successful ping, a non-zero return code, empty or dash-prefixed host rejection, and non-positive count rejection.
